description: This source file contains class definitions, interfaces, and extension methods related to integrating Orleans clustering with Cosmos DB. It includes options classes for configuration, validators, and extension methods for setting up Cosmos-based clustering and gateway list providers within Orleans hosting and client builder pipelines.

classes.name: CosmosClusteringOptions
classes.description: Represents configuration options specific to Cosmos DB clustering within Orleans.

classes.name: CosmosClusteringOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates the provided CosmosClusteringOptions to ensure correct configuration before use.

classes.name: CosmosOptions
classes.description: Base class containing options related to Cosmos DB, such as resource cleanup, client options, throughput settings, and operation execution.

classes.name: CosmosOptionsValidator
classes.description: Generic validator class for CosmosOptions, ensuring configuration correctness.

classes.name: ICosmosOperationExecutor
classes.description: Interface for executing Cosmos DB operations asynchronously.

methods.name: ConfigureCosmosClient
methods.description: Sets up the CosmosClient using a factory function for dependency injection.

methods.name: ConfigureCosmosClient
methods.description: Configures CosmosClient with an endpoint and authentication key or token credential.

methods.name: UseCosmosClustering
methods.description: Extension method to set up Cosmos DB clustering in Orleans silo or service collection.

methods.name: UseCosmosGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Extension method to set up a Cosmos DB-based gateway list provider in Orleans.
